name: Omagram
author: ReidenXerx
description: An unofficial Telegram client for Omarchy, built on TDLib: a keyboard-driven window with media, stickers and voice notes, desktop notifications with reply, a bar badge with a quick panel, and a quick-reply overlay. Not affiliated with Telegram; you use your own API id.

barWidget.description: Unread messages and quick replies (unofficial Telegram client)
